description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'EmployeeDistributionByLocation' within the OrangeHRM dashboard plugin. The class encapsulates data related to employee distribution across different locations, including counts and limits.

classes.name: EmployeeDistributionByLocation
classes.description: A data transfer object representing employee distribution data grouped by location, including counts for employees, unassigned, and total locations, with a limit for data display.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an EmployeeDistributionByLocation object with specified location count pairs, employee counts, total locations, unassigned employee count, and limit.

methods.name: getLocationCountPairs
methods.description: Returns the array of location count pairs.

methods.name: getOtherEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees outside of the main distribution.

methods.name: getUnassignedEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees with unassigned locations.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit used in the distribution display.

methods.name: getTotalLocationCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of locations.
